newsitem.title: RUSSIA: IMF head says Bulgaria government moves courageous.
newsitem.headline: IMF head says Bulgaria government moves courageous.

text.p: Bulgaria's new government is taking impressive action for a state in financial and economic collapse, the head of the International Monetary Fund said on Wednesday.
"A new government is now taking courageous steps to make up for lost time -- and they lost time," IMF Managing Director Michel Camdessus told students at a Russian international affairs institute.
He is in Moscow to discuss IMF lending to Russia with top government officials and mentioned Bulgaria in a speech on economic reform.

Camdessus said previous government indecision in Bulgaria had brought about "a vicious circle in which weak policies have resulted in poor performance and a loss of confidence, which in turn has deepened the crisis, exacerbated hyperinflation, and led to an eventual economic and financial collapse, that we are now trying to help the authorities repair."
